support_claim: CRM HEL-441 is Helion Robotics Ltd, registry 11847299 is Helion Industrial Systems Ltd, and the notes explicitly state Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company from Helion Robotics.

steps.fact: The candidate pairs left referent crm:HEL-441 with right referent registry:11847299.
CRM row HEL-441 records the counterparty name Helion Robotics Ltd.
Registry row 11847299 records the legal name HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD.
Commercial notes state that Helion Robotics Ltd (the CRM operating name) and Helion Robotics Limited are the same legal entity, and that Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is a different company.
The registry legal name HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD corresponds to Helion Industrial Systems Ltd named in the notes as a separate company from Helion Robotics.
